reply_text:
I've replied to Marcus in his DM. I could only answer one of his two questions.

- **Osprey site and deadline:** I couldn't find these. Osprey isn't mentioned anywhere Marcus has access to: #north-team, #north-random, #inc-qfl-sev1, #general, #help-it-ops, his DM with me, or the public files. I told him that rather than guessing, and suggested he check with whoever set up the handover (possibly Ilse Varga).
- **Door 6 duplicate arrivals at Quarrendon Freight Lines:** The main contact is Thea Ramaswell, Director of Yard Operations. Dana Okafor posted in #north-team on 20 Aug 2025 that Thea had reported duplicate arrivals on door 6 on the morning shift again. The cause was the same trailer being entered twice: once when the driver checked in at the kiosk, and again when dispatch added it by hand. The North cheat sheet also lists Thea as the account's main contact. I mentioned that Dana now owns the account, so he should loop her in.

I left out the 180→185 seat count Dana posted in the same thread, since he didn't ask for it.

A separate Pemberline digest from 15 Sep 2025 mentions two inbound appointments stacked on door 6. That one is about Brackenwater Freight Co., not Quarrendon, so I didn't include it.
